newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut bourse trade mixed Bank of Beirut jumps.
newsitem.headline: Beirut bourse trade mixed Bank of Beirut jumps.

text.p: Bank of Beirut maintained its momentum by touching a new high amid mixed trade on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Friday.
The LIBX bank index rose 1.08 percent to 199.83 and the LISPI climbed 0.03 percent to 97.34 while the BLOM general index fell 1.01 percent to 1113.05.
Solidere A shares dropped to $13 from $13.125 and B shares fell to $13 from $13.25 a day earlier when they received a boost from the lifting of a U.S. travel ban on Lebanon on Wednesday.
Bank of Beirut hit a high of $5.9375, up from $5.75.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce held steady at $21.75. Banque Audi shares were flat at $28.00.
Brokers had expected a stronger Solidere performance and expressed surprise at BOB's jump.
"The market was suprising concerning BOB shares. There are expectations that BOB will reach $6. There is a huge demand on the stock," said one broker who requested anonymity.
"Solidere was expected to climb," the broker added.
BSE turnover climbed to 358,121 shares from 327,033 for a value of $3,326,895 against $4,004,592.
Ciments Libanais was unchanged at $1.2813. It was last traded at that price on July 30.
There was no trade in the the other listed industrial firms -- Uniceramic, Ciments Blancs and Eternit .
